recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-26688 unless a future work-group decision reopens conditional update Resource.id behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-26688 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I correction asking to remove the conditional update sentence saying that if an id is provided the server SHALL ignore it, because it contradicted the preceding id-mismatch behavior.
initial_application: The issue was applied by f03ddacb16c1befe035bc015be04709ef3cf5560, which removed the two-line sentence from source/http.html, and was merged through HL7/fhir#1124 in fc265b034702d6da73fc86af5c727b59c5bcb74a.
additional_context: The current source/http.html conditional update section still omits the removed sentence and lists explicit behavior for no-match, matching-id, and mismatching-id cases. FHIR-36859 later refined the no-match/id case and already has a combined-branch reconcile audit, so it was not duplicated.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source already implements the approved deletion, and the only remaining 'server SHALL ignore it' occurrence is in the create interaction rather than conditional update.
